title: The Broken Hammer
text: The head of a great smith's hammer lies split in two on the forge floor, each half the size of a child. Both halves are still warm and humming. When you hold them apart, they lean toward each other like lovers.

options.label: Take a half each, and keep them well apart.

outcomes.text: Each half rides heavy and warm in a pack, always leaning toward the other as if pining.

options.label: The strongest pushes the halves together, to make the hammer whole again.

outcomes.text: They fuse with a ring like a great bell. The hammer is whole again, and glad.
They fuse with a blast that throws the strongest across the forge, arms first.

options.label: Bury the halves far apart, so they can never find each other again.

outcomes.text: The humming stops. Deep in the forge, something settles with a sigh.
